notes.title: 1.0.7 Update
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where interacting under certain conditions could prevent game progression.

Other minor adjustments.

notes.title: 1.0.6 Update
notes.notes:
・Adjusted enemy movement speed (main story only, no changes in Time Attack)
・Fixed an issue where the framerate dropped in certain stages

notes.title: 1.0.5 Update
notes.notes: ・Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would disappear when playing with keyboard and mouse while a controller was connected.

notes.title: 1.0.4 Update
notes.notes: ・Fixed an issue where players could interact with the portal at the same time they were caught by an enemy.

notes.title: 1.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
・Fixed a bug where unintended effects played during the ending branches
・Extended the grace period for certain traps
・Adjusted enemy screams so they play from the correct position
・Adjusted supporter content switches to function properly

notes.title: 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes: ・Fixed a bug that occurred after clearing Time Attack.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
・Fixed an issue where the ranking board could not be accessed
・Other minor adjustments

notes.title: Notice of Release Date Change for Mayoi Shopping Street 9/5
notes.notes:
Dear all,

This is Actor.

We would like to inform you of a change in the release date of Mayoi Shopping Street.

Originally scheduled for Friday, August 29, the release has been postponed to Friday, September 5 due to various circumstances.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to those who have been looking forward to the release.

We will continue to work hard to deliver an even better experience, and we kindly ask for your understanding and support.
